create.name: Devarshi Steven Hartman
create.bio:
Devarshi Steven Hartman is a yoga teacher, author and spiritual counsellor who lives on Maui and spends his summers teaching in New England. He began practising yoga in 1974, spent close to ten years in ashram life, and later ran professional trainings at Kripalu, where he was dean of its yoga school from 2004 to 2014. Over the decades he has certified thousands of yoga teachers, and he founded the Pranotthan Yoga School, whose 200- and 300-hour trainings are now led by senior teachers he has trained while he teaches the philosophy sessions online.

Alongside yoga, he has studied and taught A Course in Miracles since 1976, and the two strands meet in his book The Three Essentials, a mix of memoir and practical guidance built around presence, inquiry and connection. He gives weekly talks on the Yoga Sutras, pranayama and yoga nidra at Hanuman Maui, the former home of Ram Dass, and runs a four-week online course on his three principles, a year-long Course in Miracles study group and a twelve-month Acharya Intensive for committed practitioners. He also offers one-to-one spiritual coaching and has led programmes at Esalen, Omega and studios across the United States.

books.title: The Three Essentials: Timeless Yogic Principles for Inner Peace and Self-Transformation
books.author: Devarshi Steven Hartman
books.description: Part memoir and part guide, the book sets out three principles he draws from yoga philosophy and A Course in Miracles: being present, looking honestly at what arises and staying connected. Each is paired with simple daily practices.

courses.title: Living the Three Essentials (online course)
courses.description: A live four-week online course of ninety-minute evening sessions on the three principles from his book. Sessions mix short teaching, gentle movement, breathing, partner practice and silence, and include a practice guide and recordings.

courses.title: A Course in Miracles Year-Long Study Group
courses.description: A year-long online group that works through the 365 workbook lessons of A Course in Miracles. Devarshi leads fortnightly Zoom meetings and adds weekly videos and daily reflections; the next group starts in January 2028.

courses.title: Pranotthan Yoga Teacher Training (200- and 300-hour)
courses.description: Teacher trainings of the Pranotthan Yoga School, which he founded, held at a studio in Wakefield, Rhode Island. Senior Pranotthan teachers lead the course and Devarshi teaches the yoga philosophy sessions online.

courses.title: Acharya Intensive
courses.description: A twelve-month training for a small group of committed practitioners, with three five-day residential workshops, personal coaching and online mentoring. It draws on the kosha model, scripture study and a daily practice; entry is by application and the next dates are still to be announced.

courses.title: Private Spiritual Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one sessions on life direction, spiritual awakening and recurring patterns, drawing on his years of yoga and spiritual study. A free fifteen-minute call comes first to see whether the work is a good fit.
